text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Five models · fixed model/method order, not a ranking · 200 held-out examples per task · seed 42

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Intervals: recorded 95% stratified test-item bootstrap, 1,000 resamples; conditional on this split, seed and prompt.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Qwen2.5 0.5B uses LoRA; Qwen3 4B uses QLoRA. Local models rank numeric ID + EOS; OpenAI generates labels.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Jev uses native Choice via OpenRouter (typesafe/jev-1.13); it has no LoRA arm. Incomplete conditions have no dot.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: The dashed NB reference is fixed by configuration; its interval is in the report. Extra-label full-prepared baselines are omitted.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Cross-environment data/training alignment is audited separately; original differing manifest hashes are retained.
